name: Bel Airs
description: Bel Airs was a Chicago greaser street gang active in the Logan Square and Humboldt Park neighborhoods during the 1960s and 1970s. They became close allies of the Simon City Royals around 1966 after the two gangs' leaders unexpectedly met and reconciled a personal dispute. The gang was part of a broader North Side Chicago greaser alliance that also included the Gaylords, C-Notes, Insane Popes, Chi West, and PVP/PVR, whose members gathered at 4 Buddies Restaurant (Lenny's) together between roughly 1971 and 1975. Rivals included the Aristocrats, Latin Kings, and Latin Eagles. The alliance dissolved in 1975 following a series of murders among allied factions.
